list.label: View
list.name: perWorker
list.query: Aggregated : model_name,Per Worker : model_name\, instance\, worker_id

title: SGLang - UCM Linker
description: UCM linker, adapter and counter metrics only. Layer load ends when the worker observes completion; consumer wait_until includes ready callbacks and is not pure GPU stall. Nested interface durations overlap. Store internals use grafana_store.json.

panels.description: Per logical layer submission through worker wait and cleanup, including failures and ordered-reaping delay (ms) These observations have different start/end points; do not subtract them to infer forward time or an overlap ratio.

targets.expr: sum by (${perWorker:raw}, layer) (rate(ucm:sglang_linker_load_layer_duration_ms_sum{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",model_name=~"$model_name",worker_id=~"$worker_id",layer=~"$layer"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (${perWorker:raw}, layer) (rate(ucm:sglang_linker_load_layer_duration_ms_count{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",model_name=~"$model_name",worker_id=~"$worker_id",layer=~"$layer"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Layer Load: Submit to Worker Completion

panels.description: Consumer wait_until call duration by logical layer, including ready callbacks, cleanup and failures; not pure GPU stall time (ms) These observations have different start/end points; do not subtract them to infer forward time or an overlap ratio.

targets.expr: sum by (${perWorker:raw}, layer) (rate(ucm:sglang_linker_load_layer_wait_duration_ms_sum{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",model_name=~"$model_name",worker_id=~"$worker_id",layer=~"$layer"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (${perWorker:raw}, layer) (rate(ucm:sglang_linker_load_layer_wait_duration_ms_count{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",model_name=~"$model_name",worker_id=~"$worker_id",layer=~"$layer"}[$__rate_interval]))
